title: Cà Phê Sữa Đá
description: Strong dark-roast coffee dripped slowly through a phin filter onto sweetened condensed milk, then poured over ice.
notes: Vietnamese robusta, coarsely ground, is traditional. A French press at double strength is the fallback without a phin.

steps.text: Spoon the condensed milk into a heatproof glass.
Put the coffee in the phin over the glass, press lightly, and add a splash of the hot water to bloom.
steps.tip: Blooming lets the grounds swell, so the rest of the water drips slowly rather than rushing through.

steps.text: Fill with the remaining water, cover, and let it drip through.
steps.tip: Four to five minutes is right. Much faster means the grind is too coarse.

steps.text: Stir the coffee into the condensed milk and pour over a glass of ice.
